game.name: Super Mario Sunshine
game.rules:
### **Timing**  

Time starts when pressing A to select 'Yes' to create a new file, or when pressing A to select 'Start' on an eligible starting file (see below).
Time ends when you land the final ground pound in the Bowser fight.

### **Starting file**  

For convenience, you may start from one of these save files:

- Peach file: a file obtained by saving right after F.L.U.D.D.’s tutorial cutscene on the airstrip. Add 2:30.35 to your time to make up for the skipped cutscenes. (For PAL at 50Hz, use 2:30.38). For 3DAS also use 2:30.35.
- Hacked file: a file that cannot be created within the game, see [the Guides section](https://www.speedrun.com/sms/guides) for how to set it up. Add 5:40.41 to your time to make up for the skipped cutscenes.  (For PAL at 50Hz, use 5:40.48)

### **Requirements**

- Runs must be real-time (No pausing the timer).
- Emulator and Nintendont is not allowed for runs faster than the threshold defined in the Category Rules.
- Video proof is required for runs faster than the threshold defined in the Category Rules.
- Videos are required to show the game clearly and contain game audio.

### **Rules**

- Macros, including the use of turbo functions, is banned.
- Notch calibration, and therefore adapters and PHOBs that expressly calibrate notches, is allowed.
- The use of disc adapters for GameCube discs is banned.

### **Recommendations**

- Submit your runs with video if you have the ability to do so, regardless of the requirements.
- Upload your splits to splits.io and add them to your submission, especially if you don't have a video.
- [Gecko OS](http://wiibrew.org/wiki/Gecko_OS) is the preferred app for playing discs from other regions. Priiloader and AnyRegion Changer are also fine. If you want to use a different method, please contact a moderator first.
- [Metacor's Emu Guide](https://imgur.com/a/qj6vrmM) is the preferred method of setting up emulator.
- 3DAS runs should be submitted without a region selected.
- If you have any questions, contact a moderator. The best place to do this is in the [Community Discord](https://discord.gg/jX38aXCv9y).

categories.name: 120 Shines
categories.rules:
**Goal**
Collect every Shine Sprite in the game for a grand total of 120 Shine Sprites.

**Requirements**

- Emulator and Nintendont is not allowed for runs faster than 3 hours 40 minutes.
- Video proof is required for runs faster than 3 hours 40 minutes.
- The use of ACE is banned.

categories.name: 96 Shines
categories.rules:
**Goal**
Collect every Shine Sprite in the game, excluding those obtained from trading in blue coins, for a grand total of 96 Shine Sprites.

**Requirements**

- Emulator and Nintendont is not allowed for runs faster than 3 hours.
- Video proof is required for runs faster than 3 hours.
- The use of ACE is banned.

categories.name: 79 Shines
categories.rules:
**Goal**
Collect every Shine Sprite in every world, and beat the game (Defeat Bowser in Corona Mountain), for a grand total of 79 Shine Sprites.

**Requirements**

- Emulator and Nintendont is not allowed for runs faster than 2 hours 45 minutes.
- Video proof is required for runs faster than 2 hours 45 minutes.
- The use of ACE is banned.

categories.name: All Episodes
categories.rules:
**Goal**
Collect every Shine Sprite obtained from completing episodes in the game worlds (8 per world), and beat the game (Defeat Bowser in Corona Mountain), for a grand total of 58 Shine Sprites.

**Requirements**

- Emulator and Nintendont is not allowed for runs faster than 1 hour 50 minutes.
- Video proof is required for runs faster than 1 hour 50 minutes.
- The use of ACE is banned.

categories.name: Individual World
categories.rules:
Complete episodes 1-7.
In Bianco Hills, you may skip episode 1.
In Pinna Park, you may perform Early Yoshi Go-round instead of episodes 5 and 6.
All forms of Gelato Beach Skip are banned.
Do not use FLUDD in secret levels.

- Timing starts when you select the first shine and ends when Mario holds up the final shine.
- 1st place runs must include video.
- Emulator, SD and USB are all banned.
- The use of ACE is banned.

categories.name: Any% Hoverless
categories.rules:
**Goal**
Beat the game (Defeat Bowser in Corona Mountain) without using the Hover Nozzle.

**Requirements**

- Emulator and Nintendont is not allowed for runs faster than 1 hour 40 minutes.
- Video proof is required for runs faster than 1 hour 40 minutes.
- The use of ACE is banned.

categories.name: All Shines
categories.rules:
Collect all 11 Shines in the world (8 episodes, 2 hidden Shines, 100 coins)
Do not use FLUDD when collecting the first Shines in Secret levels (e.g. Bianco 3, Pinna 2)

- Timing starts when you select the first shine and ends when Mario holds up the final shine.
- 1st place runs must include video.
- Emulator, SD and USB are all banned.
- The use of ACE is banned.

categories.name: Full Completion
categories.rules:
Complete all shines and collect every blue coin in the world.
Do not use FLUDD when collecting the first Shines in Secret levels (e.g. Bianco 3, Pinna 2)

- Timing starts when you select the first shine and ends when Mario holds up the final shine.
- 1st place runs must include video.
- Emulator, SD and USB are all banned.
- The use of ACE is banned.

categories.name: All Blue Coins
categories.rules:
**Goal**
Collect and trade in all 240 blue coins, then beat the game (Defeat Bowser in Corona Mountain), for a grand total of 68 Shine Sprites.

**Requirements**

- Emulator and Nintendont is not allowed for runs faster than 2 hours 20 minutes.
- Video proof is required for runs faster than 2 hours 20 minutes.
- The use of ACE is banned.

categories.name: 20 Shines
categories.rules:
**Goal**
Collect 20 Shine Sprites (19 without including Airstrip).
Race File must be used. This file is obtained by playing the game normally until reaching Delfino Plaza after the court cutscene, then saving and quitting.
Timing ends when the Shine Sprite counter ticks over to the number 20.

**Requirements**

- The Timing Method variable is to be left blank for 20 Shines runs.  
- Emulator and Nintendont is not allowed for runs faster than 22 minutes.  
- Video proof is required for runs faster than 22 minutes.
- The use of ACE is banned.
